answer_1.quote: We propose a strong benchmark for automatic protoword reconstruction, by applying a set of machine learning models (using various feature sets and architectures) on any cognate set of Romance languages.

answer_2.quote: The metrics used include accuracy, (normalized) edit distance, and Cov_i, with i ∈ {1, 5, 10}, which stands for an extended version of the accuracy metric...

answer_4.quote: We also provide a comprehensive human evaluation of the results. Linguists from our team manually analyzed the entire list of results...
answer_4.guideline: distinguish forms that were genuinely erroneous from those whose differences from the dictionary form were either insignificant or represented a correct adjustment to the reality of Latin pronunciation.
